name: Homeward — Daily Silence Check & Caregiver Reminder

parameters.content:
## Before you run this

1. **"Call Silence Check" node** — replace the URL with your deployed (or tunnelled) Homeward URL, e.g. `https://your-app.example.com/api/silence-check`. If n8n runs in Docker/cloud and Homeward runs locally, `localhost` won't be reachable — use ngrok or deploy first.
2. **Same node** — replace the `X-Silence-Check-Key` header value with your real `SILENCE_CHECK_SECRET`.
3. **"Send Reminder Email (Resend)" node** — replace the `Authorization` header value with your real Resend API key, and replace the `from` address with a sender on a domain verified in your Resend account (Resend rejects unverified senders).
4. **caregiverEmail is captured at plan creation** (components/OnboardingFlow.tsx) and is optional — a patient can leave it blank. The Filter node in this workflow drops any patient without one, which is expected: those patients just don't have a reminder recipient on file yet.

**v2 update:** the API's response fields were renamed — `lastCheckinDate`/`hoursSinceLastCheckin` are now `lastActivityDate`/`hoursSinceLastActivity`, plus a new `lastActivityType` ("checkin" | "presence_ping" | "plan_created"). This reflects a new "I'm okay" presence-ping button on the patient dashboard that also resets this clock, without counting as a real check-in. If you imported the earlier version of this workflow, re-import this file to pick up the field renames — the old field names will just come back `undefined` in the email otherwise.

Flow: Schedule (9am daily) → GET /api/silence-check → split silentPatients[] into one item each → keep only ones with a caregiverEmail → POST to Resend per patient.
